title: bug: no MoeDaemonSupervisorTest row pins that a surviving old supervisor root refuses a Windows Restart Daemon (OldTree.survivor() includes roots)
description: Test gap found by RF04's QA (qa-952969be, comment-6125c6f7 on task-f3f364a6) and handed to CQ-RF07. The code is correct at 28df02f7, but a mutant that drops `roots` from MoeDaemonSupervisor.OldTree.survivor() passes every existing MoeDaemonSupervisorTest row. Without that term, a supervisor root that survives TerminateProcess could respawn `_run` after Restart Daemon reports success. QA's probes QA1-QA4 (a surviving root in both profiles; a PROTECTED STOP_FAILED signals nothing and gates starts; NOT_STARTED_HERE while a tree is retained; pid 0/-1 is never looked up or signalled) are in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/qa-rf04-qa-952969be/qa-probes.patch with mutant-roots-survivor.log. Adopt them as permanent rows. This is test-only; no production change is expected.
definitionOfDone: MoeDaemonSupervisorTest gains rows equivalent to QA1-QA4; the QA1 row fails when `roots` is dropped from OldTree.survivor() and passes on the unchanged production code.
No production byte changes; `cmd.exe /d /c "cd /d D:\projexts\moes\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test --rerun"` exits 0 under the jetbrains-gradle lease.
reopenReason: Human "move from backlog": CQ-RF07 residual (MoeDaemonSupervisorTest gap for surviving supervisor roots).
